subject: Re: Training-on-customer-data opt-out confirmation

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmefin.com>, procurement@acmefin.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Training-on-customer-data opt-out confirmation

Hi Alex —

Great to speak with you earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and the remaining ask on the privacy side:

Summary of what we discussed
- Data types: AcmeFin will send transaction metadata and customer support transcripts (PII redacted at source where possible).
- Logging: Request for request/response logs to be retained for 30 days for debugging, with redaction rules for SSNs/CC numbers.
- Data residency: Primary inference in us-west-2; backups in us-east-1.
- Model training: AcmeFin requested "training-on-customer-data" opt-out so submitted inputs are not used to improve Redwood models.

Action items for today
1) Please confirm in writing that you want Redwood to exclude AcmeFin data from model-improvement pipelines (training opt-out).
2) If procurement prefers, sign the attached standard opt-out form (we can accept DocuSign).
3) Confirm retention window for logs (default 30 days) and any exceptions.

I attached the DPA excerpt and our standard opt-out form for convenience. Once we have the signed opt-out we will:
- Tag all AcmeFin tenant data with opt-out metadata;
- Exclude tenant data from any model improvement queues;
- Update the deal record and notify Legal/Platform.

Thanks — happy to hop back on a quick call if you want to walk through the form.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0179

Attachments: redwood-dpa.pdf (excerpt), acmefin-optout-form.pdf (blank)
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmefin.com>

Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Training-on-customer-data opt-out confirmation

Neha —

Thanks for the clear summary and for sending the form. I confirm that AcmeFin requests an opt-out: please exclude any AcmeFin tenant data from Redwood's model improvement/training pipelines.

Retention: 30 days for debug logs is fine. We do not need long-term request/response retention beyond that window.

Data residency: keep inference and short-term logs in us-west-2; no cross-region analytics without prior written approval.

I've signed the attached opt-out form and sent it via DocuSign. Link below and attached PDF stub:
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEF123456

If you need a PO or formal SOW change to reflect this, loop procurement (cc'd).

On the training side: is there a confirmation receipt you can send once the opt-out is in effect and tagged on the tenant? A short note or an internal ticket ID will work.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Head of Integrations, AcmeFin
alex.johnson@acmefin.com
+1 617-555-0123
